verdict.rationale: Companies House makes its register machine-readable by design: every record has a unique URI retrievable via simple GET requests on a public REST API with free registered keys, and the probe confirms structured JSON responses. That gives a real open-format route to a company's own filed data. However, nothing in the pack documents a user-facing 'export all my data' feature, bulk download, or an account-exit path. Missing for 10: documented bulk or complete account-data export, explicit open-format specification for exports, evidence covering filings and documents beyond per-record API GETs, independent hands-on corroboration of a full export.
